bio.text: Dennis Guth is a Republican state senator for Iowa Senate District 28 and has served in the Iowa Senate since 2013.

The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Guth as a farmer at Guth Farms, Inc., with a B.S. in agricultural mechanization from Iowa State University, born in 1955 in Belmond and living on the family farm outside Klemme.
It says Guth is a former president of the Hancock County Farm Bureau and of the Klemme Area Development Organization, and a past member of the board of The Family Leader.
